'''Varti''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who was a citizen of [[Athar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[JanFathal]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> he worked alongside with [[Merish Hath]] and [[Shil Kaval]] when they later were accompanied by Orla Taman, who was revealed to be [[Hallena Devis]], an undercover Republic agent. He later participated, along with the local rebels, in an uprising against the Republic-aligned [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the planet. When Devis's position as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] was revealed, he, along with Merish and Shil took her hostage. When the Republic strike team arrived to rescue Devis, he was shot by [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] at point blank range.
